title: 연락 부탁하고 방법 묻기: 도착하거든, 가려면
objective: By the end, you can make the forms of -거든 and -(으)려면 and choose the right one in a sentence. You will know that -거든 needs a request, suggestion, or promise after it.
summary: Learn two condition endings: -거든 for "if/when this happens, please do that" and -(으)려면 for "if you want to do this, you need that."

task.title: Choose, complete, and check
task.line: Use -거든 for "if/when this happens, do that" and -(으)려면 for "to do this, you need that"; change each word to the right form.

forms.when: Any verb stem, with or without a final consonant. The second part must be a request, advice, suggestion, or promise (-(으)세요, -(으)ㄹ까요?, -(으)ㄹ게요).
forms.exampleMeaning: When you get home, please send me a text.

forms.when: Use it for a state. The second part is still a request, advice, or suggestion.
forms.means: if (you are / it is) like this, do that
forms.exampleMeaning: If you have a headache, go home early today.

forms.form: Verb stem ending in a vowel or ㄹ + 려면
forms.when: Verbs only. The second part says what you need or must do (-아/어야 해요, 필요해요, -(으)세요, -(으)면 돼요).
forms.means: if you want to / to (do this), …
forms.example: 시청에 가려면 몇 번 버스를 타야 해요?
forms.exampleMeaning: Which bus do I have to take to get to City Hall?

forms.form: Verb stem ending in a consonant (not ㄹ) + 으려면
forms.when: Verbs only. Note: ㄷ irregular: 듣다 → 들으려면, 걷다 → 걸으려면; ㅂ irregular: 돕다 → 도우려면; ㅅ irregular: 짓다 → 지으려면.
forms.means: if you want to / to (do this), …
forms.example: 좋은 자리에 앉으려면 일찍 가야 해요.
forms.exampleMeaning: If you want a good seat, you have to go early.

watchOut: 비가 오거든 길이 막혀요 (X) → 비가 오면 길이 막혀요 (O): after -거든, use a request, suggestion, or promise. Do not use it with a plain fact; use -(으)면 for that.
만들으려면 (X) → 만들려면 (O): stems ending in ㄹ take -려면 only, with no 으.
듣으려면 (X) → 들으려면 (O): with 듣다 and 걷다, ㄷ changes to ㄹ before 으.
예쁘려면 (X) → 예뻐지려면 (O): -(으)려면 goes with verbs. Do not add it to an adjective stem.
exercises: Choose the right form: ① 은행 계좌를 (만들거든 / 만들려면) 여권이 필요해요. ② 이 약을 먹고도 열이 (나거든 / 나려면) 병원에 가 보세요.
Fill in the blank with -(으)려면: ① 한국 노래를 잘 ____ 많이 들어 보세요. (부르다) ② 주말에 바다에서 ____ 수영복을 챙기세요. (놀다) ③ 이 강의를 다 ____ 두 시간이 걸려요. (듣다)
Fill in the blank with -거든: ① 수업이 일찍 ____ 같이 커피 마실까요? (끝나다) ② 밤에 ____ 창문을 닫고 주무세요. (춥다)
Is the sentence correct? Write O or X. If X, fix it: ① 회의가 끝나거든 바로 전화할게요. ② 봄이 오거든 꽃이 피어요. ③ 사진을 찍으려면 저쪽으로 가세요.

Complete the sentence for the situation with -거든 or -(으)려면: ① Your friend wants a cheap ticket. Tell them to book early: 표를 싸게 ____ 일찍 예약하세요. (사다) ② Your friend is going to the store. Ask them to buy milk if the store has some: 가게에 우유가 ____ 하나 사 와 주세요. (있다)
answers: ① 부르려면 ② 놀려면 ③ 들으려면
① O ② X → 봄이 오면 꽃이 피어요. ③ O
